description: This file is an HTML webpage that integrates the CodeMirror editor for editing and displaying N-Triples and N-Quads RDF data formats. It sets up syntax highlighting with CodeMirror and includes example datasets for these RDF serialization formats.

methods.name: CodeMirror.fromTextArea
methods.description: Initializes a CodeMirror editor instance from a specified textarea element, enabling syntax highlighting and other editor features.
